name: Alpinolino
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpinolino alpine discovery park on the Talkaser in Westendorf delights families with interactive nature and riddle stations.
preis: Discovery park free of charge; Alpenrosenbahn cable car requires ticket (Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card valid)
oeffnungszeiten: Mid-May to late October daily from 08:30 to 17:00
beschreibung:
Overview

The popular alpine adventure park Alpinolino Westendorf sits at an elevation of approximately 1,770 meters surrounding the mountain terminal of the Alpenrosenbahn on the Talkaser in the Kitzbühel Alps. Designed as an interactive nature playground and outdoor discovery park, Alpinolino transforms the rolling alpine pastures and shaded mountain forests above Westendorf into an exciting open-air classroom for children, families, and nature enthusiasts. Guided by the motto 'Look closely, wonder, and learn', young and old explorers meet the clever marmot mascot 'Schlauberger', who accompanies visitors along themed educational trails. At lovingly crafted activity stations, sensory paths, and puzzle stops, visitors playfully uncover fascinating facts about alpine flora, wildlife adaptations, and high-altitude weather phenomena against sweeping panoramas of the Brixental.

Route & Requirements

Ascending to Alpinolino is swift, comfortable, and barrier-free aboard the modern six-seater Alpenrosenbahn I and II gondolas departing from Westendorf directly to the Talkaser summit. The 1.5-kilometer main 'Himmelsteig' trail and the 'Holzwurmweg' circular loop feature gentle gradients and are largely navigable with all-terrain pushchairs. For the leisurely circuit, which takes about 1.5 to 2 hours of easy walking, standard hiking shoes with grippy soles and basic fitness are entirely sufficient. More adventurous families can extend their outing along the slightly more demanding 'Kreuzjöchl High Trail' leading to an idyllic reservoir lake with panoramic views of the Hohe Tauern peaks. Along the routes, wide wooden relaxation loungers and picnic spots invite restful breaks in fresh mountain air.

Visit & Arrival

Alpinolino Westendorf is freely accessible daily from 08:30 to 17:00 during the summer operating season of the cable cars from mid-May to late October. Gondola tickets are purchased at regular Bergbahn Westendorf rates; the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card is accepted. Drivers reach Westendorf via the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Wörgl Ost), following the B178 and B170 through the Brixental (large free car park at the valley station). Train passengers travel comfortably with the ÖBB to Westendorf in Tirol railway station, which lies just a ten-minute walk from the cable car terminal.

Tips

Pick up the free Alpinolino puzzle booklet at the Alpenrosenbahn valley station so your children can collect stamps at each discovery station and earn a surprise reward. A stop at the Talkaser mountain restaurant rounds off the family day with authentic Tyrolean dishes.
